title: cordula charlesworthii
intro: Cordula charlesworthii, commonly known as Cordia, is a plant species within the Boraginaceae family. It is a flowering plant native to tropical and subtropical regions, used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Cordia charlesworthii include its ability to lower blood pressure and reduce inflammation, while its therapeutic actions include acting as an antioxidant and antimicrobial agent. The bioactive constituents of Cordia charlesworthii include flavonoids, alkaloids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
